name: At Dylan's Mercy
source:
A visual novel fearing Dylan the Bun's characters tormenting you after you find yourself unexpectedly reduced to a significantly smaller-than-usual size.

[From [url=https://dragonien.itch.io/at-dylans-mercy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部视觉小说，担心当你发现自己意外地缩小到比平常小得多时，小面包迪伦的角色会折磨你。

[来自[url=https://dragonien.itch.io/at-dylans-mercy]Itch.io[/url]]
